# Cladding Alloy Properties Comparison

| Alloy | Density (g/cm^3) | Melting point (K) | Youngs modulus (GPa) | Thermal conductivity (W/(m K)) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Zircaloy-4 | 6.56 | 2128 | 99 | 16.0 |
| M5 (Zr-1NbO) | 6.51 | 2133 | 95 | 14.5 |
| FeCrAl | 7.10 | 1793 | 201 | 15.5 |
| SiC (CVD) | 3.21 | 3103 | 410 | 120 |
| SS316L | 7.99 | 1673 | 193 | 15.0 |

Cladding selection involves trade-offs among neutronic penalty, corrosion resistance, and accident tolerance.
